text: Doppelrahm is cream standardised to at least 45 % fat, so much fat that it is spooned rather than whipped. Traditionally the cream rises on whole milk left standing after milking, being the lightest part; the Fribourg Gruyère-region double cream is made this way from Gruyère-region milk.
